title: Weird "problems" that solved themselves between real life and mallworld?
content: Okay so lately I've been having this thing where small issues in my real life are solved in mallworld, and then in my dream I'm trying to figure out how to actually send it to my real life self! For example, i really needed a puzzle board last week to finish my puzzle on. Guess what? Puzzle board manifests in my dream, just simple white cardboard poster boards i would use exactly for a puzzle board. So i found two at the shop and took them back to my mallworld house. This is the first time I've ever had something like this happen. And the past few days I've been repeatedly in the same mallworld house pondering "damn, i need these irl. How can i get them there? I own them here, so i own them there." And i will touch the puzzle boards and try to "feel" a way to send it. Yall if i wake up and there is a real life puzzle board that i manifested from mallworld... imma freak out!
